Anything classified binary is dropped before doxygen or any parser sees it (`filetypes.py`, `cli.py:_drop_binary_files`). ... JS/TS and other claimed types (`synth.py:claims`) are not read by doxygen. They come from the parse-built front end, using the same scanned file set.
